Jeremiah Thompson here. Independent researcher.

My research partner, Justin Horowitz, and I built a learning architecture with no weights and no training data. It constructs candidate abstractions, a hard verifier accepts or rejects each one. We put out a preprint on it called "Manifold Destiny."

I owe this community an apology. I opened a big PR (158 lemmas across a bunch of fields) before introducing myself or talking to anyone here. That's not how you do this and I know better now. The PR also didn't compile inline and the style was off. The reviewer gave me honest feedback and I pushed back harder than I should have.

The lemmas are fixed now. They compile inline against current master in proper style. I want to contribute these the right way, and I want to follow the process.

I will post the project details in the "#AI AND LEAN" - "AI authored projects".

Hi everyone

I'm Owais, an AI/ML Engineer with background in Mathematics & CS.

I'm getting into Lean/formal math because I'm interested in the intersection of AI and formal reasoning — things like using LLMs for autoformalization, AI-assisted theorem proving, and how formal verification can ground AI-generated math.

Looking forward to learning from everyone here!
